entities.name: T3480
entities.description: EPS session management timer for bearer resource allocation procedure. Timer value is 8 seconds in WB-S1 mode, 16 seconds in WB-S1/CE mode.

entities.name: T3481
entities.description: EPS session management timer for bearer resource modification procedure. Timer value is 8 seconds in WB-S1 mode, 16 seconds in WB-S1/CE mode.

entities.name: T3482
entities.description: EPS session management timer for additional PDN connection request. Timer value is 8 seconds in WB-S1 mode, 16 seconds in WB-S1/CE mode.

entities.name: T3492
entities.description: EPS session management timer for PDN disconnect procedure. Timer value is 6 seconds in WB-S1 mode, 14 seconds in WB-S1/CE mode.

entities.name: T3493
entities.description: EPS session management timer for remote UE report procedure. Timer value is 4 seconds in WB-S1 mode, 12 seconds in WB-S1/CE mode.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: EPS session management state where a procedure transaction is pending completion.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request bearer resource allocation.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request bearer resource modification.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request additional PDN connection.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN disconnection.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to report remote UE information.

relations.description: Timer T3480 operates in PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING state
Sending BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST starts timer T3480
